court_name: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
petitioner: The Principal, Modern College of Arts, Science and Commerce, Shivaji Nagar, Pune- 5

directives.text: The judgment and order dated 19 November 2014 passed by the learned Member, Industrial Court, Pune in Complaint (ULP) No. 202 of 2009 is quashed and set aside
Complaint (ULP) No. 202 of 2009 filed by the respondent stands dismissed

raw_summary: The Bombay High Court allowed a writ petition, quashing and setting aside an Industrial Court order that had held the petitioner institution guilty of unfair labour practices and directed payment of salary arrears. The High Court dismissed the complaint, finding that the respondent had not sufficiently pleaded her case for unfair labour practice and had failed to establish parity with employees on aided posts.
